description: Returns EU steel and safeguard tariff quota rows taken from the tables of official Official Journal acts: order number, product, CN codes, country, tonnes per period and out-of-quota duty. Use it for allocated quota volumes; use trade_list_measures for the regulations themselves, and TARIC for live remaining balances. Inputs (all optional, they narrow together): cn (CN/TARIC code, 4 to 10 digits, e.g. 7208; matches broader and narrower codes on the first 8 digits), country (name part, e.g. India), order_number (e.g. 09.9801), celex (exact act, e.g. 32026R1457), history (true also returns rows replaced by later acts; default false keeps the newest act per order), limit (1 to 50, default 20) and cursor (next_cursor, same filters; paging only, not a change checkpoint). Output: quotas[] with order_number, product, CN codes, country, period tonnes, duty and act URL, plus count, has_more, next_cursor and feed freshness (checked twice a day). Not live quota availability. Terms: read-only; MCP calls are never charged. Without a key, metered routes give 10 successful answers a day free (unmetered routes are unlimited); errors do not count. On the paid HTTP routes, errors and empty answers are free. An optional API key keeps its prepaid-credit policy. When the free answers run out, the error names the HTTP alternative.

celex.description: Exact regulation CELEX: 3 + four-digit year + R + four digits, e.g. 32026R1457; omit for all acts

cn.description: CN/TARIC code, 4 to 10 digits after removing spaces and dots, e.g. 7208 or 72085120

country.description: Country name substring, 3 to 60 Unicode letters or spaces/punctuation (period, apostrophe, parentheses, hyphen), e.g. India; omit for all countries

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from this tool's prior answer; q followed by 1 to 6 digits, e.g. q0. Keep filters unchanged; omit on first call.

history.description: Also rows replaced by later acts (default false)

name: trade_list_quotas
title: List EU tariff quota tables
